## Availability Limitada

While I'm considering some jam sessions and live shows here in Costa Rica, I'm currently unavailable for bookings of any kind until late July, 2028. First I need to return home to Uxmal just past the 2028 spring equinox, then I have some business to take care of.

If that timeline works for you, then your _type_ of booking matters next.

content.text: ## Art Shows + Festivals I've gotta say, after the show alongside SESA PURE ([Main Site](https://sesapure.com/)) at Two Goats Pottery for EAST in 2017, truly a multimedia event for the senses, I think we might've peaked. Maybe. There's also the other side, putting on events at festivals and TAZ-spaces like Burning Man, or Desert Hearts -- like my massive "[Celestial Return](celestial-return)" surreal fractal mural at the Mystic Flyer Experience ([Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/MysticFlyerExperience/)) for Desert Hearts (shown on the left). There's moments where you're like, "Yeah. I'm done. Time to tap out because there's no outdoing that one." Then you find a way to do things in a different way. Maybe, just fucking maybe, you find out an even better way. If you have a unique event you're planning, or festival you're putting together, and think I'd make a good part of it then [contact me](#?/contact). Give me a ring, ding, ding. We'll do tea and crumpets, eh? I'll likely be working with SESA PURE again to add my fractals to tea tins (omg Burnt Texas Chai was amazing!), to tea boxes, and bringing these tastes back to other art shows in the future.

## Private Parties

Wait, did you think I meant a "wedding" by a private party? Oh my sweet summer child. I don't do weddings. _Get. The. Fuck. OUT!_ See that photo of our lil ranch in Ojai for NYE, 2008? I'll let your imagination run wild. That's about two hours before the real party began and everyone arrived. The rest of the world didn't even know it happened. To everyone there though? It marked them. It's a scar worn with honor... a foundation stone in the future that would follow.

However, if you reading this know what a true transformative space is and you're planning to change some lives, count me in! Count me the fuck in! If you want to drop some coin on it, sure, all good. But for the right private party in the right place, just give me a line to plug into and a sky to tear asunder. I'll fucking make it rain on the right night.

I've played solo as DJ Jaya Prime and with a group as San Jaya Prime over the course of more than a decade. I've played clubs that were legally closed, private events in dungeons after the tourists had gone home, and at least two masquerades on the sacred night of All Hallow's Eve. [Send me a line](#?/contact) and tell me just what you've got in mind. We'll have ourselves a palaver.

While most request me for DJing "[The ADHD Revolution](adhd-revolution)" or "[Blood of the Moon](blood-of-the-moon)", I have a wide range and love mixing it up. That includes whether or not I mix in quotes (which has become my signature style) and if you'd like a specific theme or even a story to be told. But again, don't even try booking for a wedding unless it's a burner wedding like we did for Paije, where we even built the stage and then burned it all down as a part of the night's revels.

Note: Please tell me someone was there at the house party somewhere out near Marble Falls and Burnet? The one where I was DJing from the stop of the stairs above the downstairs? Which is fucking weeeeeiiirddd because almost no house in Texas has a basement, but I remember that one... . I just can't fucking pinpoint it in my mind and was never able to find it again. [Contact me](#?/contact) if you've got the deets!

texts:
## Underground Concerts

I think the daywalkers still call them "raves" if you can believe it. They go to clubs, a place they can always return to if they'd like. Not us. We dance in ruins, in abandoned warehouses. This night only happens once. ONCE! And then it's gone. All of it. Fuck it's tearing my heart apart right now just to write about it. If you know, you know, and I fucking love you for it. It's a pain and a beauty that's true, it's inside of you, and it's worth every fucking second to make it happen. Even if we get shut down, and holy shit we get shut down! Even then! Even then it's worth it. Never forget the ruins you made your mark on.

Because they'll never forget you. Not any of us. And not a single one of you.

So if you think you're booking me for a concert or show "on the reg" you've got another thing coming. You see, I want _that_ pain. The most legal shows I've played are at Burning Man and on a whim at SXSW. You see these ruins? We took over that demo site and lit it all to hell, splicing wires to run them across the concrete from the apartments that they hadn't yet laid waste to. If you think I'm trading this magic for some stage in a club or arena you're wrong. Separation from the dancers? The crowd shouldn't be "off in the distance" and far away from you, they should be _with_ you. WITH YOU! Seriously, do you "get it" yet? At least a little bit of it? Because even at Burning Man the dancers are with you, climbing the scaffolding to reach you, hell fucking dancing in your arms! They get it. But do YOU?

And IF that IS you... if you DO fucking get it... you know how to [reach me](#?/contact).

Oh FUCK! And HOPE! Our improv show at the glorious graffiti ruins of HOPE Art Gallery just days before they locked us out. I've gotta stop writing. This is fucking killing me.

_And I wouldn't change it for the world._

PS: Some of our best underground music is wrapped into the "[Warriors in Waiting](warriors-in-waiting-live-set)" live set, which hopefully will actually survive this time. None of our covers are in there, no remixes, so I think this one might fight to live another day. There's evidence and a trail of dead for all our other shows. I even found a few old blog entries like from one of our SXSW shows ([Blogger](https://mallofme.blogspot.com/2009/03/sxswsxsv-2009-full-set-for-free.html)), and of course all of those got killed by the industry. So this time around, the covers and remixes are hidden away safely.

### Booking Requirements

Let's not have another situation like at Easy's. Which, I'm going to rant for a second, because you don't fucking call yourself a "speakeasy" IN MOTHERFUCKING LAS VEGAS and then NOT allow smoking. So FUCK YES we were smoking on stage! Lol, and yet another one where we got cut early. This time banned. I wear it as a badge of honor and they couldn't even beg me to come back. But with that, let's get some things out there in front:

1.  Smoking is required, which includes cigarettes, cigars, and marijuana.
2.  Alcohol is required, as we bring wine and other drinks on stage... 'n I've gotta be honest, that may or may not also change hands with other fans and dancers.
3.  If this is a private party, then we need a soundcheck a day in advance with at least an hour to feel out the levels and acoustics. For underground events, I get it! Hell, half or more than half never even happen. No soundcheck needed just let us know the likeliness of being raided so that we can prep appropriately. We're no strangers to dodging the cops.

_But if you missed it at the beginning, then I'll remind you here at the end... I'm not available until the end of July in 2028. I've got my team to take care of... and I've got a homecoming to attend._

./end:transmission
